_doc: NPB park factors. Schema matches DugoutSide (runs, hr, roof, lat, lon, altitudeFt, cfBearingDeg). Values: 1.00 = neutral, >1.00 = hitter-friendly, <1.00 = pitcher-friendly. IMPORTANT — `runs`/`hr` values below are ROUGH PRIORS from public NPB consensus; they need to be back-calibrated from 2-3 seasons of historical results before the engine ships. `cfBearingDeg` (home plate → CF, deg from N clockwise) is TODO until we wire up the weather/wind axis.
_calibrationStatus: DERIVED — runs + HR factors from 2024-2025 corpus

TOKYO_DOME.name: Tokyo Dome
TOKYO_DOME.notes: Classic 'rabbit hutch' — small dimensions, dome air, hitter-friendly. Giants home park since 1988.

KOSHIEN.name: Hanshin Koshien Stadium
KOSHIEN.notes: Famously pitcher-friendly. Huge outfield, sea breeze. Hosts summer high-school tournament; Tigers play road games for ~2 weeks in August.

MAZDA.name: Mazda Stadium
MAZDA.notes: Asymmetric, roughly neutral. Open-air, modest weather influence.

JINGU.name: Meiji Jingu Stadium
JINGU.notes: Small park, hitter-friendly. Highest HR factor in NPB along with Tokyo Dome.

VANTELIN.name: Vantelin Dome Nagoya
VANTELIN.notes: Pitcher-friendly dome. Deep alleys; lowest HR factor in NPB.

PAYPAY.name: Mizuho PayPay Dome
PAYPAY.notes: Retractable roof. Usually closed (Fukuoka humidity). Roughly neutral.

ZOZO_MARINE.name: ZOZO Marine Stadium
ZOZO_MARINE.notes: Coastal, very windy (Tokyo Bay). Pitcher-friendly on most nights; wind direction critical.

BELLUNA.name: Belluna Dome
BELLUNA.notes: Covered open-air — roof exists but walls don't. Treat as open for wind, but rain protected. Highest altitude in NPB (still low).

RAKUTEN.name: Rakuten Mobile Park Miyagi
RAKUTEN.notes: Open-air. Slightly pitcher-friendly. Sendai weather can be cool early/late season.

KYOCERA.name: Kyocera Dome Osaka
KYOCERA.notes: Pitcher-friendly dome. Larger dimensions than Tokyo Dome.

ES_CON.name: Es Con Field Hokkaido
ES_CON.notes: New park (2023). Retractable roof, asymmetric, slightly hitter-friendly so far. Limited sample.
